subjects.label: Car damage and wrecking
subjects.description: The soft-body damage model and the carnage it enables: dents and crumpling, losing wheels and being wrecked out of a race, the damage-level setting, destructible track objects, and the pleasure of smashing opponents; not the driving physics or track design as such.

subjects.label: FlatOut successor
subjects.description: Whether this is the true heir to FlatOut 1 and 2 from the same studio, what it keeps from them and what it lost; comparisons to other racers or demolition games belong in the fixed genre subject.

subjects.label: Vehicle roster and novelty cars
subjects.description: The cars on offer: how many there are, which ones players favour, and the joke vehicles such as the lawnmower, sofa, combine harvester, bus and toilet on wheels; not how cars handle or break.

subjects.label: Game modes, tournament and events
subjects.description: Which modes exist and how they play: demolition derby versus racing, the tournament and its seasonal events, sandbox and stunt modes, and requests for modes that are missing; not the core driving and damage mechanics.
